steps.text: Talk to Iruka in the Academy yard

dialogue.speaker: iruka
dialogue.text: Ah, there you are! You must be our new student. Welcome to the Hidden Leaf Academy. I'm Iruka Umino, your instructor.

dialogue.speaker: iruka
dialogue.text: The graduation exam is only weeks away, so we'll have to work hard. Any questions before we start?

lines.speaker: iruka
lines.text: Ha, polite too! You'll fit right in.

choices.text: When do I learn the cool jutsu?

lines.speaker: iruka
lines.text: Ha! You sound just like Naruto. First things first.

dialogue.speaker: iruka
dialogue.text: Go and meet your classmates in the yard first. You'll be training beside them every day.

dialogue.speaker: naruto
dialogue.text: Hey! You're the new kid, right? I'm Naruto Uzumaki, and I'm gonna be Hokage someday!

dialogue.speaker: naruto
dialogue.text: So everybody's gotta respect me! ...Starting with you. Believe it!

lines.speaker: naruto
lines.text: Heh heh! Biggest dream in the whole village!

lines.speaker: naruto
lines.text: Hey! Just you wait, I'll show everybody!

dialogue.speaker: sasuke
dialogue.text: I'm not here to make friends. Don't slow me down.

dialogue.speaker: sakura
dialogue.text: Oh, hi! I'm Sakura. Have you met Sasuke yet? Isn't he amazing?

dialogue.speaker: ino
dialogue.text: Back off, Forehead, nobody asked you! I'm Ino. Sasuke sits next to ME, by the way.

dialogue.speaker: shikamaru
dialogue.text: New kid, huh? I'm Shikamaru. This is Choji. Don't expect much from me... what a drag.

dialogue.speaker: choji
dialogue.text: *crunch* Hi! You can have one chip. Just one. ...Okay, maybe not.

dialogue.speaker: iruka
dialogue.text: Lively bunch, aren't they? Good. Lessons begin now, starting with the most important thing a shinobi has: chakra.
